sentences.en: We're planning a trip to North America this summer.
sentences.zh: 我们打算这个夏天去北美洲旅行。

sentences.en: North America is home to many diverse cultures and languages.
sentences.zh: 北美洲有很多多元的文化和语言。

sentences.en: Did you know that North America has the longest coastline in the world?
sentences.zh: 你知道北美洲拥有世界上最长的海岸线吗？
